name: widget-ingest
description: Public widget endpoint. Opens a new ticket. Auth v2: visitor_token in body. Looks up an existing person entity by email (read-only, FTS-safe via sanitizeQ); leaves customer_substrate_id null if no match — support never writes person entities (CRM populates the graph). Kicks the SupportTicketDO agent loop via ctx.invokeDO (no shared secret).
